# cloudinary_upload_preset (Resource)

Manages a Cloudinary upload preset within a product environment through the [Admin API](https://cloudinary.com/documentation/admin_api#upload_presets). Upload presets bundle the parameters applied to every upload that references them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The provider resolves the product environment's Admin API credentials through
# the Provisioning API, so no secret appears in configuration or state.
resource "cloudinary_upload_preset" "uploads" {
  product_environment = cloudinary_product_environment.example.id

  name                                 = "acme-videos"
  unsigned                             = false
  type                                 = "upload"
  asset_folder                         = "acme-videos"
  use_asset_folder_as_public_id_prefix = true
  use_filename                         = false
  unique_filename                      = false
  use_filename_as_display_name         = true
  overwrite                            = true
  invalidate                           = true
  allowed_formats                      = ["mp4", "mov", "webm"]
}

# eval can carry a credential into a preset as a bare value, so it is sensitive.
resource "cloudinary_upload_preset" "with_eval" {
  product_environment = cloudinary_product_environment.example.id

  # Pin the key so rotating other keys does not touch this preset.
  access_key = cloudinary_access_key.terraform.name

  name                                 = "credential carrier"
  unsigned                             = false
  type                                 = "upload"
  use_filename                         = false
  unique_filename                      = false
  use_filename_as_display_name         = true
  use_asset_folder_as_public_id_prefix = false
  overwrite                            = true
  eval                                 = random_password.example.result
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the upload preset. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `product_environment` (String) The ID or cloud name of the product environment to act on. The provider resolves the Admin API credentials for it through the Provisioning API. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `access_key` (String) The name of the access key to authenticate with. Defaults to the oldest enabled key of the product environment. Pin it to keep key rotation from touching every resource.
- `accessibility_analysis` (Boolean) Return an accessibility analysis.
- `allowed_formats` (List of String) Formats accepted for upload. Any supported type is allowed when unset.
- `asset_folder` (String) Full path of the folder the asset is placed in. Dynamic folder mode only.
- `auto_chaptering` (Boolean) Auto-generate video chapters. Video only.
- `auto_tagging` (Number) Confidence threshold for automatic tagging, between 0.0 and 1.0.
- `background_removal` (String) Background removal add-on to apply.
- `backup` (Boolean) Back up the uploaded asset, overriding the product environment default.
- `categorization` (String) Comma-separated list of categorization add-ons.
- `cinemagraph_analysis` (Boolean) Return a cinemagraph score. Animated images and video only.
- `colors` (Boolean) Return the predominant colors of the asset.
- `context` (Map of String) Key-value contextual metadata to attach to the asset.
- `detection` (String) Detection add-on to apply.
- `disallow_public_id` (Boolean) Whether uploads using this preset are forbidden from specifying a public ID.
- `discard_original_filename` (Boolean) Discard the original filename.
- `display_name` (String) User-friendly name for the asset. Defaults to the public ID.
- `eager` (String) Pipe-separated list of eager transformations to create on upload.
- `eager_async` (Boolean) Create eager transformations asynchronously.
- `eager_notification_url` (String) Webhook URL to notify when eager transformations complete.
- `eval` (String, Sensitive) JavaScript logic evaluated before the upload finalises, used to modify upload parameters. It is treated as sensitive because it is also used to carry credentials into a preset.
- `exif` (Boolean) Return the Exif metadata.
- `faces` (Boolean) Return the coordinates of detected faces.
- `filename_override` (String) Sets the `original-filename` metadata header instead of the uploaded filename.
- `folder` (String) Folder to place the asset in. Legacy fixed folder mode only; use `asset_folder` in dynamic folder mode.
- `format` (String) Format to convert the asset to before saving, e.g. `mp4`.
- `headers` (String) HTTP headers to add to responses when delivering the asset.
- `image_metadata` (Boolean) Return the image metadata.
- `invalidate` (Boolean) Invalidate CDN cached copies of the asset and its transformations.
- `live` (Boolean) Whether the preset may be used for live streaming uploads.
- `media_metadata` (Boolean) Return IPTC, XMP and detailed Exif metadata.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Custom metadata fields, keyed by external ID.
- `moderation` (String) Moderation behaviour, depending on the enabled add-ons.
- `notification_url` (String) Webhook URL to receive the upload response.
- `ocr` (String) OCR add-on to apply.
- `on_success` (String) JavaScript logic to update the asset after a successful upload.
- `overwrite` (Boolean) Overwrite an existing asset with the same public ID.
- `phash` (Boolean) Return the perceptual hash of the asset.
- `public_id` (String) Identifier used for accessing and delivering the uploaded asset.
- `public_id_prefix` (String) String prepended to the public ID with a slash.
- `quality_analysis` (Boolean) Return a quality analysis score.
- `raw_convert` (String) Generate a related file based on the uploaded raw file.
- `resource_type` (String) File type: `image`, `raw`, `video` or `auto`.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags to assign to the asset.
- `transformation` (String) Incoming transformation to apply before saving.
- `type` (String) Delivery type: `upload`, `private` or `authenticated`. Defaults to `upload`.
- `unique_display_name` (Boolean) Ensure the display name is unique within its asset folder.
- `unique_filename` (Boolean) Append random characters to the filename to ensure uniqueness.
- `unsigned` (Boolean) Whether the preset allows unsigned uploads. Defaults to `false`.
- `use_asset_folder_as_public_id_prefix` (Boolean) Prefix the public ID with the asset folder.
- `use_filename` (Boolean) Use the original filename as the public ID when none is given.
- `use_filename_as_display_name` (Boolean) Assign the original filename as the display name.
- `visual_search` (Boolean) Index the asset for visual search.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the form `<cloud_name>/<name>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# "<product_environment>/<name>", where the environment is an ID or a cloud name.
terraform import cloudinary_upload_preset.uploads acme-prod/acme-videos

terraform import cloudinary_upload_preset.with_eval "acme-prod/credential carrier"
```
